newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks seen falling on PTCL report.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks seen falling on PTCL report.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Tuesday and dealers said a sell recommendation by Credit Lyonnais Securities Asia (CLS) for the telecom utility PTCL might pull the index down on Wednesday.
CLS issued a research report saying cut in accounting rates with U.S.-based telecom carriers and lower domestic call volume growth would hit PTCL earnings.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 2.46 points, or 0.16 percent, to end at 1,519.58. Losers led gainers 146 to 88. Turnover rose to 55 million shares from 54 million on Monday.
Muslim Commercial Bank rose 0.50 to 34 rupees.
Dewan Salman Fibre fell 0.20 to 36.40 and PTCL
Hub Power Co fell 0.15 to 35.55, Shell Pakistan
